Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered [[Blizzard 2 (Revised)]] (October 1998) and on its black-bordered [[Blizzard 2 (Reflections Foil)]] (12 January 2000).
